message.content: During their meeting at "Central Perk," Li Hua proposed several design elements for Yuriko's studio homepage. Specifically, Li Hua suggested adding a user feedback section, which would include a simple form for users to leave comments or suggestions, along with a star rating system to evaluate the service quality. Additionally, Li Hua recommended incorporating testimonials to build trust among potential clients. These suggestions were part of a broader discussion about enhancing the visual appeal and engagement of the homepage, aiming to make it more welcoming and informative for visitors. Li Hua emphasized the importance of matching the overall aesthetic of the studio, suggesting pastel colors that would create a calming and inviting atmosphere. The goal was to develop a visually appealing and functional homepage that could effectively engage users and provide valuable insights into the speech therapy services offered.
